Subject: Torque wrench calibration reminder
Status: ACTIVE
Description: All torque wrenches used on inverter terminations and busbar connections must be within current calibration. Check the calibration sticker before each use. Wrenches due for recalibration shall be tagged and returned to the tool store. The tool store will arrange calibration with the external lab. Do not use a torque wrench with an expired sticker or a missing tag.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-11
Issue Date: 2023-09-06
Subject: Safety harness inspection – annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Annual inspection of all safety harnesses and lanyards. Check webbing for cuts, fraying, or UV damage. Check buckles and D-rings for deformation or cracks. Check stitching on all load-bearing seams. Harnesses failing inspection are to be cut and disposed of immediately. Inspection record to be signed by the technician and the safety officer.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-12
Issue Date: 2023-10-11
Subject: Inverter cooling fan cleaning – bi-annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Clean cooling fans and intake filters on all central inverters. Use compressed air at low pressure to avoid damaging fan blades. Check fan operation by observing startup and run speed. Note any bearing noise or vibration. Cleaning is due before the hot season and again after the rainy season.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-13
Issue Date: 2023-11-15
Subject: DC cable insulation resistance test – annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Perform insulation resistance test on DC circuits during annual shutdown. Test each string at 1000 V DC. Record values in the insulation test sheet. Flag any reading below 1 MΩ for further investigation. Do not test strings while the inverter is connected. Coordinate with the operations team for shutdown schedule.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-14
Issue Date: 2023-12-13
Subject: Lighting protection system inspection
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Inspect lightning arrestors and earth pits. Check surge arrestors on the DC side of inverters for indication of operation. Measure earth pit resistance. Resistance should be below 10 Ω. If a pit fails, treat with earth resistance reducing compound and re-test. Report any damage to the lightning protection system immediately.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2024-01
Issue Date: 2024-01-17
Subject: Safety reminder – working at height
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Reminder that all work above 1.8 m requires a harness and a second person on the ground. Do not climb on module mounting rails without a proper ladder or platform. Inspect the ladder before use. Secure tools to prevent drops. Any incident involving a dropped object must be reported on the same day.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2024-02
Issue Date: 2024-02-21
Subject: Combiner box torque check – after maintenance
Status: ACTIVE
Description: After any maintenance work on combiner boxes, verify torque on all DC termination lugs. Use the calibrated torque wrench. Refer to the manufacturer torque specification on the inside cover of the combiner box. Record torque values in the maintenance log. This check applies to all work, including fuse replacement and string testing.

MB-2023-03
Issue Date: 2023-02-27
Subject: Inverter cooling fan filter replacement interval
Status: SUPERSEDED (by MB-2023-10)
Description: Replace inverter cooling fan filters every 6 months OR when differential pressure across the filter exceeds 60 Pa, whichever comes first. Use only OEM or approved equivalent filters. Dispose of old filters in the e-waste bin, not general waste.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-04
Issue Date: 2023-03-15
Subject: Solar tracker stow procedure – high wind warning
Status: ACTIVE
Description: When high wind warning is received from site weather station (gust > 45 km/h), stow trackers to the designated stow angle (15°). Do not wait for central control instruction if the site is isolated. Confirm stow completion via the tracker controller status screen. This bulletin supersedes the informal email guidance from Jan 2023.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-05
Issue Date: 2023-04-10
Subject: Battery room ventilation check
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Verify battery room ventilation fans operate and airflow direction is correct (exhaust to outside). Check louvers for obstruction. Perform monthly, first week of the month. Report any fan failure immediately to the shift lead, not just in the weekly report.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-06
Issue Date: 2023-05-05
Subject: Emergency stop button functional test – quarterly
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Test all E-stop buttons on inverters, combiner boxes, and the main AC panel. Test shall be done with the equipment in a safe state and following the lockout/tagout procedure. Record test results in the E-stop test log. Any button that fails is to be tagged out and replaced before the equipment is returned to service.

The maintenance bulletin log shows Maintenance Bulletin MB-2024-03 issue_date as 2024-03-14. Record status: current.

MB-2023-07

Description: Visual inspection of all DC fuses in combiner boxes for signs of overheating (discoloration, melting, charring). Check fuse holders for tightness. Subject: Oil leak check – transformer pad
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Monthly visual check of transformer pads for oil stains or pooling. If a leak is found, identify the source (bushing, tank weld, cooling fins) and report to the maintenance supervisor. Do not attempt to tighten bushings while transformer is energized. Photograph the leak and upload to the shared drive under "Transformer Leaks" folder.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-09
Issue Date: 2023-07-12
Subject: Cable trench cover inspection after heavy rain
Status: ACTIVE
Description: After any rainfall event exceeding 25 mm in 24 hours, inspect all cable trench covers for displacement, cracking, or missing sections. Secure any loose covers immediately. Log inspection date and rainfall amount in the trench inspection sheet. Pay special attention to trenches near access roads.

MB-2023-10
Issue Date: 2023-08-09
Subject: Torque wrench calibration reminder
Status: ACTIVE
Description: All torque wrenches used on inverter terminations and busbar connections must be within current calibration. Check the calibration sticker before each use. Wrenches due for recalibration shall be tagged and returned to the tool store. The tool store will arrange calibration with the external lab. Do not use a torque wrench with an expired sticker or a missing tag.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-11
Issue Date: 2023-09-06
Subject: Safety harness inspection – annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Annual inspection of all safety harnesses and lanyards. Check webbing for cuts, fraying, or UV damage. Check buckles and D-rings for deformation or cracks. Check stitching on all load-bearing seams. Harnesses failing inspection are to be cut and disposed of immediately. Inspection record to be signed by the technician and the safety officer.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-12
Issue Date: 2023-10-11
Subject: Inverter cooling fan cleaning – bi-annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Clean cooling fans and intake filters on all central inverters. Use compressed air at low pressure to avoid damaging fan blades. Check fan operation by observing startup and run speed. Note any bearing noise or vibration. Cleaning is due before the hot season and again after the rainy season.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-13
Issue Date: 2023-11-15
Subject: DC cable insulation resistance test – annual
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Perform insulation resistance test on DC circuits during annual shutdown. Test each string at 1000 V DC. Record values in the insulation test sheet. Flag any reading below 1 MΩ for further investigation. Do not test strings while the inverter is connected. Coordinate with the operations team for shutdown schedule.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2023-14
Issue Date: 2023-12-13
Subject: Lighting protection system inspection
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Inspect lightning arrestors and earth pits. Check surge arrestors on the DC side of inverters for indication of operation. Measure earth pit resistance. Resistance should be below 10 Ω. If a pit fails, treat with earth resistance reducing compound and re-test. Report any damage to the lightning protection system immediately.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2024-01
Issue Date: 2024-01-17
Subject: Safety reminder – working at height
Status: ACTIVE
Description: Reminder that all work above 1.8 m requires a harness and a second person on the ground. Do not climb on module mounting rails without a proper ladder or platform. Inspect the ladder before use. Secure tools to prevent drops. Any incident involving a dropped object must be reported on the same day.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MB-2024-02
Issue Date: 2024-02-21
Subject: Combiner box torque check – after maintenance
Status: ACTIVE
Description: After any maintenance work on combiner boxes, verify torque on all DC termination lugs. Use the calibrated torque wrench. Refer to the manufacturer torque specification on the inside cover of the combiner box. Record torque values in the maintenance log. This check applies to all work, including fuse replacement and string testing.
